body.statement:
For closed convex sets \(A_0,A_1\subseteq\mathbb R^d\) and \(0<t<1\), Gaussian measure satisfies the Ehrhard--Borell inequality
\[
\Phi^{-1}\!\bigl(\gamma_d((1-t)A_0+tA_1)\bigr)\ge(1-t)\Phi^{-1}(\gamma_d(A_0))+t\Phi^{-1}(\gamma_d(A_1)).
\]
When both measures lie strictly between zero and one, equality for weights summing to one occurs only when the sets are parallel half-spaces or when \(A_0=A_1\), apart from Gaussian-null modifications.

attestation.note: Checked against the primary arXiv PDF; the node records only the convex-set inequality and the weights-summing-to-one equality alternatives used in the proof.
